title: Board Schedule of Patron Factors Applied to Grain Marketing Contracts Carry
content:
The patron factor applied to the delayed price carry on Grain Marketing Contracts recognises the member's standing in the cooperative's equity, held under Membership and Patronage Equity.

| The member's equity account | Patron factor applied to the carry |
|---|---|
| Carries voting rights, and the allocations posted to it over the last eighteen months reach 2500 | 0.85 |
| Stands active, but that pair of conditions is not met | 0.95 |
| No active equity account stands in the member's name | 1.0 |

## Reading the bands

The first band asks for two things together: voting rights on the equity account held under Membership and Patronage Equity, and allocations posted to that account over the last eighteen months reaching 2500. Allocations of 2500 reach it, the figure itself qualifying; 2,499 does not, and the account then takes 0.95 so long as it stands active. Where no active equity account stands at all, the carry is taken at 1.0 and the factor makes no difference to the figure.

## Illustration on hypothetical figures

A hypothetical carry arrived at as 800.00 before the patron factor is applied comes to 680.00 where the member's equity account carries voting rights and eighteen months of allocations of 3,100; to 760.00 where the account stands active without meeting that pair of conditions; and stands at 800.00 where no active equity account is held.
